Use on recurring task-4fbd50f1 instances with a uniform background and sparse diagonal color motifs. Re-derive rays from each fresh test and any demos; the confirmed instance is a strong prior, not a guarantee.

# task-f9a61bc4 — 2x2 core and cyclic diagonal rays

## Rule, established by demo and correct test
A 2x2 block of color 2 is the core. Four distinct colored markers lie diagonally outward from its four corners: NW, NE, SW, SE. Transform these into four outward diagonal rays, preserving the 2x2 core and extending each ray to the grid boundary. Colors rotate one quadrant clockwise from the marker's location to the ray direction:

- NW marker color is used for the outward NE ray.
- NE marker color is used for the outward SE ray.
- SE marker color is used for the outward SW ray.
- SW marker color is used for the outward NW ray.

Equivalently, move the marker colors clockwise around the square's four diagonal directions, then extend outward from each corresponding corner. Recolor the original marker cells as part of their rays; do not preserve their old color when it differs. Fill intervening cells along only those four diagonals; preserve all unrelated cells and the central 2x2.
